properties.description_en:
Due to repairs on the bridge over Hoffellsá, the bridge on Hornafjarðarvegur (987), the old Ring Road, will be closed to all traffic from 1:30 PM on Monday, October 5, until 12:00 AM (midnight) on Thursday, October 8.
It will not be possible to drive across the bridge while the closure is in effect. Travelers are asked to use Road 1 across Hornafjarðarfljót during the closure period.
There will be no toll charges on Road 1 around Hornafjörður while the Hoffellsá bridge is closed."
properties.description_is:
Vegna viðgerða á brú yfir Hoffellsá verður brúin á Hornafjarðarvegi (987), gamla Hringveginum, lokuð allri umferð frá kl. 13:30 mánudaginn 5. október til kl. 00:00 fimmtudaginn 8. október. 
 
Ekki verður unnt að aka um brúna á meðan lokun stendur yfir. Vegfarendur eru beðnir um að nota Hringveg 1 um Hornafjarðarfljót á lokunartímanum.
Engin gjaldtaka verður á Hringvegi 1 um Hornafjörð á meðan Hoffellsárbrú er lokuð.

properties.description_en: Arnarnesvegur has been reopened to traffic from Breiðholtsbraut via the new bridge over Breiðholtsbraut to Vatnsendavegur. Drivers are advised to drive to and from Vatnsendahvarfi via Vatnsendavegur, a new roundabout at Arnarnesvegur and a new intersection at Breiðholtsbraut.
